description: Per-seller offers for scraped Amazon ASINs -- condition (+ normalized condition bucket, + seller-provided condition note on used offers), price, seller name/rating, ships-from, delivery estimate, Prime flag, fulfillment type (FBA/FBM/AMAZON, when derivable), free-delivery flag/shipping price (when Amazon gives explicit evidence either way), and buy-box winner flag. The actor pages through Amazon's own offer list (10 offers per page) up to the requested cap.

offers.description: Dataset containing all scraped Amazon offer and status records.
offers.title: Amazon offers
